subject: as.mcmc.list exported in rstan sometime soon?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: as.mcmc.list exported in rstan sometime soon?
parts:
Hi!

The function as.mcmc.list is a non-exported function of rstan which makes me feel "bad" using it. Is this function planned to be exported in a future rstan version? It is very handy to have in order to plug rstan into code which expects coda formatted mcmc list objects! I suppose this is something which would make the switch to stan from WinBUGS or JAGS much easier for a number of library writers.

Best,
Sebastian

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: as.mcmc.list exported in rstan sometime soon?
parts:
People have libraries for doing things like plotting
that are based on Coda format. And people have said they
want some of the convergence diagnostics other than R-hat
that coda gives you.

It also makes it easier to do things like comparisons of
n_eff and R-hat and other convergence calcs that go both
ways. And some people trust software like Coda that's been
around longer than they trust Stan.

- Bob
